messages:
emily: Heads-up 1 Ali Rahman (intl) starts Monday. BG vendor says missing local police certificate (country: PK). Candidate says embassy can issue but timeline is 5-7 days. Hes asking if we can still do day-1 I-9 and benefits orientation. cc: @rachel @it-support @facilities

rachel: If police cert is delayed we can proceed with provisional I-9 methods: authorized representative or in-person verification when he arrives. We need an attestation form and scanned docs uploaded within 72h of hire.

bg-checks-bot: Background check alert for Ali Rahman (Order #BG-90211): "Missing police certificate (country PK)"  vendor requests applicant-supplied certificate or background letter from consulate. Portal: https://bg.vendor/portal/GHI789 (72h expiry).

candidate-ali: I can be in town Tuesday evening. Embassy appointment earliest Wed. I can bring passport + residence card and a letter from local police station (in Urdu) 1 will that work for now? Also I use NVDA screen reader 1 need keyboard-only onboarding.

emily: Thanks Ali. Legal says passport + residence card + police letter (even local-language) plus translated summary is acceptable for provisional clearance. We'll flag for manual review. We'll also mark ADA requirement: keyboard-only and captioned videos for benefits.

it-support: Noted accessibility needs. We'll provide a keyboard-only walkthrough and ensure captions on the benefits deck. IT can issue temporary SSO credentials and remote VPN access day-1. Please confirm preferred laptop OS.

facilities: For in-person pickup, Visitor Lot D has early-bird passes. We'll issue a day-pass and schedule a short escort for Alis arrival. If he needs entry after hours let us know.

emily: Plan: 1) Send agent attestation option + expense guidance for embassy/notary fees. 2) Book keyboard-accessible orientation slot and captioned materials. 3) IT to provision temporary account before Monday. 4) Candidate brings passport + residence card + police letter; upload scans to BG portal asap. We'll allow provisional start with contingent clearance. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.

rachel: Agent attestation link: https://redwood.company/onboard/agent-attest.pdf. Expense form for consulate/notary: https://expense.redwood/submit.

candidate-ali: Appreciate it everyone. Preferred OS: Windows. Will upload scans tonight and keep you posted on embassy slot. Thanks for accommodation.

it-support: Account prepped for ali.rahman@redwood.com, Windows image queued for next-day. VPN invite sent.

emily: Great 1 we'll checkpoint on Monday morning 8:30am PST in Lobby A. Ali 1 please ping here if anything changes. :wave:
